mechanism.hypothesis: Factory knowledge may fragment under component-by-component genetic transmission; isolate packet integrity and role-dependent source scoring in a fixed 2x2.
mechanism.scope: Keep fixed FA contexts; never enable H1 context renewal or combine the two mechanisms.
mechanism.routing: Three boundary physical groups, family particles only; separate opportunity counter for each family x direction; invoke every fourth opportunity. CENTER retains the original composition.
mechanism.frequency: No forced constant per-generation invocation count. With50 opportunities per counter the first full generation produces12 invocations and the next13; publish actual counters including partial generations.
mechanism.target_factory: Choose the parent factory with maximal direction-specific local c/e/w objective; ties use the smallest factory id.
mechanism.shared_draws: From the same target-factory pool draw three pairs of records, six nextInt calls. All four variants consume the same number of draws.
mechanism.ROLE: For each pair choose the record with smaller direction-specific local objective; a tie keeps the first record.
mechanism.RANDOM: Keep the first record of each drawn pair while still consuming all six draws.
mechanism.PACKET: Transfer the first selected record complete JS/MA/WA tuple.
mechanism.MOSAIC: Transfer JS, MA and WA respectively from the three selected records and align by job.
mechanism.marginal_control: For a fixed eligible prefix and pool, component source marginals match across PACKET/MOSAIC; only their correlation changes.
mechanism.cost: Every invoked proposal consumes one ordinary successful evaluation if completed, including repeated encodings; no greedy acceptance, proposal filtering or changed invocation rate.
mechanism.unchanged: Preserve FA, all other factories, the old sharing path, four physical roles, Q settings, and every common search/budget/QA rule.
mechanism.observation: Bounded factory-transfer.jsonl and complete summary.cooperation.factoryTransfer counters; exact schema must be installed before performance.
mechanism.common_checkpoint_evidence: SNAPSHOT_GENOMES enabled identically for every method; all reached checkpoints have a whole-model replayed four-vector witness.
mechanism.claim_boundary: Report both ordinary packet-integrity effects and direction-dependent source-scoring effects plus their interaction. Any single candidate-vs-baseline win cannot establish synergy.
mechanism.continuation: No parameter tuning, second version, H1+H2 combined mechanism, or automatic broad matrix.
